findings.claim: The new ReportIfLocatedInCompilation wrapper drops every diagnostic whose Location is not in a syntax tree of the compilation, including Location.None. MsgPack00x diagnostics produced via GetLocation helpers that return null (metadata symbols) are silently suppressed. This is the intended fix and matches ledger L8, but the wrapper also suppresses any diagnostic with a null/None location for source types, such as when FirstOrDefault returns null. Diagnostics that guard users against insecure or unsupported configurations (e.g., MsgPack016/MsgPack008 on AOT-unsupported features) could be dropped without notice. The security impact is minimal, because these are compile-time diagnostics and not runtime protections.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the analyzer tests for MsgPack diagnostics on source-declared types, including ones that may produce Location.None, and confirm that each expected diagnostic is still reported after the wrapper.
